title: Impact of UV intensity, water temperature, and turbidity on solar disinfection efficiency: insights from moderated mediation analysis using the Johnson–Neyman technique
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2025, 11,1909-1923
DOI: 10.1039/D5EW00466G, Paper
Ekene Jude Nwankwo
This study investigated the bacterial inactivation effects of solar disinfection (SODIS) by separating direct UV inactivation from temperature-mediated mechanisms using moderated mediation analysis.
